scenes.text: This tutorial covers Annotate. Review single-object crops on a grid and assign reliable labels for model training or quality control.
Open Annotate from the Core section. Open a project with object crops and select the database table and annotation column.
In the main configuration area, choose classes, display channels, sorting, sampling, and any filters that define the review set.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. label representative objects, save frequently, and revisit uncertain or conflicting examples.
When the workflow finishes, annotations are written back to the project database with object identifiers intact.
